why: Choi and Lee's paper (arXiv:2212.00636, revised May 2025, published in Advances in Mathematics 2025) proves Newman's conjecture holds for a density-1 set of moduli with at least two distinct prime divisors, and explicitly for M = 2,5,7,13,17,19,29,31 -- specific cases of the conjecture settled, though the conjecture remains open in general.
